entry.title: Turtle Tower
entry.note: Exact Q1134533 way178995269 agrees with the published 6.28 by 4.54 m footprint. Hanoi tourism describes the third-floor circular 0.68 m opening and inscription on the east facade. Native +Z is this east-facing long elevation and +X points north. The documented island ground is the base datum; the surrounding lake and grass island remain mapped terrain. The small island and lake are host terrain/water, not part of this monument mesh. Island ground contact requires terrain data to retain the island instead of generalizing it into water. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
